decisions.diagnosis: After the tubes were reinstalled following the June-July 2022 outage the two directions are swapped (East labelled 251 carries the westbound flow and vice versa) until the next reinstall on 2022-11-08; totals are right, and the series below reassign the parts.
decisions.evidence: Workday share of the 07-09h+17-19h peaks that is in the morning: East 0.77-0.81 / West 0.24-0.26 in Mar-May 2022, East 0.19-0.24 / West 0.76-0.78 in Jul-Oct 2022, back to East 0.77 / West 0.24 from 2022-11-09; daily totals stay balanced (e.g. 2022-08-02 E 140 W 133).

decisions.diagnosis: After the 2024-10-17/18 interruption the directions are swapped again for the rest of the record; totals are right, and the series below reassign the parts.
decisions.evidence: Morning share of peaks: East 0.79-0.81 / West 0.19-0.22 Jan-Sep 2024 and to 2024-10-16 (E am 64 pm 15), then East 0.16-0.22 / West 0.72-0.82 every month Nov 2024-Sep 2026 (2024-10-21 E am 8 pm 61, W am 58 pm 10); E/W weekly ratio stays about 1.0.

decisions.diagnosis: Tube failure: eastbound went to zero from mid-morning 2023-06-26 (already set missing) and westbound kept registering only a small fraction of its riders until the full outage from 2023-06-30.
decisions.evidence: West daily 31, 30, 10, 19 against 779-830 per week (about 115 per weekday) in the surrounding weeks; East 0 on the same days; normal E/W ratio about 1.0.

decisions.diagnosis: Westbound detection dropped out for the day while eastbound counted normally, then recovered the next day.
decisions.evidence: 2021-04-24 West 9 (hourly 0-2) vs East 62; on every other full day of counter 108 the E/W ratio is 0.35-0.65 of the total; 2021-04-25 West 61, East 71.

series.name: Eastbound (citybound)
series.evidence: Counter 210 (same tube model) replaced 108 at the same site after a 4-week gap with a similar level (Dec 2021 ~104/day, Feb 2022 ~94/day per direction); the citybound flow is the one with the morning peak (AM share ~0.78), which sits in 253 during the two swapped periods.

series.name: Westbound (outbound)
series.evidence: Same replacement as above; the outbound flow is the one with the evening peak (AM share ~0.22), which sits in 251 during the two swapped periods.

summary: Railway Ave, Stanmore is a clean, well-balanced tube site: counter 108 (2021) was replaced by counter 210 (2022 onward) at a comparable level, and the automatic zero_outage fixes correctly remove the tube outages. The main problem is that the direction labels of counter 210 are swapped from 2022-07-27 to 2022-10-31 and from 2024-10-18 to the end, shown by the morning and evening peaks changing sides after reinstalls; the series reassign the parts accordingly. Two short partial-detection episodes (westbound 2021-04-24 and 2023-06-26 to 06-29) are set missing.
